# Complete retained Ultra2 native fixture

`cases.bin` contains 32 immutable native cases, 93 actual blocks and 123 algorithm
phases, including 30 discarded seed passes. All 229657 logical events are
preserved with complete sparse parser/search/frequency state, eligibility and
rebase records, phase-local sequences, actual repeat-owner publication, native
allocator ledgers and complete wire frames. Names, source bytes, frames and
case ranges are borrowed by the Rust reader; observation vectors are bounded
and fallibly allocated. The fixture is never a production candidate provider.

The projection pins the completed native report and archive, rehashes every
regular captured file, and preserves its independently audited state records.
It inherits the already completed native model replay/forgery qualification;
it does not claim another native or model execution. Ordinary/optimized Python
produce identical binary and provenance bytes.

The seven independent reader/decode tests pass in safe, nineteen isolated unsafe,
all-features and release/all configurations: 22 products, each with seven passed
and zero failed/ignored tests. All 21 true no_std products compile; formatting
and strict Clippy for the changed integration target pass. Tests cover complete
inventory/borrowing, all native frames decoded by Rust, first/later thresholds,
future-source isolation, truncation/oversized domains, reset/owner forgeries and
later query/path/frequency/search mutations. The production retained Ultra2
parser and public strategy-9 extension remain unimplemented at this checkpoint.
